user.title: Gobel Battery
user.description: Choose the BMS and how Home Assistant should connect. You can change this later via Reconfigure.

reconfigure.title: Reconfigure Gobel Battery
reconfigure.description: Update the connection or BMS settings. Home Assistant reloads the device afterwards.

init.title: Gobel Battery options
init.description: Expert mode makes Pace and TDT settings writable. Wrong current limits or MOSFET switches can disconnect the battery or remove its protection. Turn the option off again after the change. The controls disappear and the read-only sensors return. JK and passive Pace WiFi stay read-only.

expert_warning.title: Expert mode
expert_warning.description: The BMS configuration becomes writable. A wrong charge limit, discharge limit or MOSFET switch can stop charging, stop discharging, or leave the battery without its configured protection. Continue only if that risk is understood. The mode can be switched off afterwards.

data.confirm_expert: I understand the risk and want to change BMS settings

error.expert_not_confirmed: Confirm the warning before enabling expert mode.

abort.reconfigure_successful: Configuration updated. The device will reload.
